test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In how many years will a sum of Rs. 10,000 become Rs. 13,310 at 10% compound interest per annum, compounded annually?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs. 10000

Amount = Rs. 13310

Rate of interest = 10% per annum

**Formula used:**

A =P (1+{R over 100})^n

Where, A = Amount,

C.I = Compound Interest, 

P = Principle,

r = Rate o
